notes: Discovery via sitemap.xml only (robots.txt disallows '/recipes?', so the listing pager was not crawled). The /recipes listing header says 1382 recipes; the sitemap has 1383 English /recipes/<slug> URLs and 1451 Spanish /es/recipes/<slug> URLs (listed = 1383 + 1451 = 2834). Spanish pages are the site's own translations, kept as lang 'es' records with source_id 'es-<slug>'; 1341 are linked to their English page (translation_of = English source_id, sharing its category/diet/dish/cuisine/method and photo): 1341 via sitemap hreflang and 0 with no hreflang link matched by identical photo + calories; 37 Spanish records stand alone (no English counterpart found). lang comes from <html lang>, except Spanish-language recipes published under /recipes/ with lang=en, which are set to 'es'. Sitemap vs listing: of the 1383 English sitemap URLs, 9 301-redirect to the homepage for anonymous visitors and 1 is a landing page, which gives the listing's 1382 if the listing counts the unpublished ones too (it cannot be paged under robots.txt to check); 74 Spanish URLs also 301 to the homepage; see skipped.json. 194 records have no steps because they are single-food entries used in the site's meal plans (e.g. 'Orange, medium', 'Almond butter'); they are kept. Spanish pages leave serving size blank and keep some ingredient notes in English, as published. Photos: image_url is the uploaded original; the downloaded copy is the site's 1440w hero rendition (recipe_hero_banner_720w_2x, at most 1440 px wide, usually ~973x779), with the original as fallback. Per language: en {'scraped': 1370, 'with_image': 1370, 'with_nutrients': 1370}, es {'scraped': 1378, 'with_image': 1378, 'with_nutrients': 1378}. Parsed from page HTML (the JSON-LD splits ingredients/steps on commas and omits potassium). Nutrition panel mapped per serving; added_sugar_g only from the 'Added Sugars' row; saturated/trans fat and total sugars are kept in nutrients_extra. No phosphorus/calcium values or diabetes exchanges/choices appear on the pages, so food_choices/carb_choices are empty. Ingredient text = US quantity + name (+ note); the metric column is ignored. diet: 'Diabetes' for all, plus tags Gluten-Free, Vegetarian/Vegan, CKD Dialysis -> Dialysis, CKD Non-Dialysis -> CKD non-dialysis ('Kidney-Friendly', 'Low Sodium', 'Low Carb' have no matching value). Extra fields kept per record: tags, credits, nutrients_extra. Origin intermittently returned HTTP 503 'Technical Difficulties' pages (not a bot challenge); these were retried with backoff.
